 Match Preview
 LaLiga - Game Week 12 Nov 7, 2026 - 09:15 RCDE Stadium Espanyol host Deportivo de A Coruna at the RCDE Stadium in Barcelona in a LaLiga fixture that carries genuine urgency for the home side.
 Eder Sarabia takes charge of an Espanyol squad sitting 14th in the table, a position that reflects a difficult run of form and a club still adjusting after a managerial change. Sarabia replaced Manolo Gonzalez following a turbulent period that included a Copa del Rey exit to fourth-tier Sestao, and he will need an immediate response from his players.
 The visitors arrive in considerably better shape. Deportivo de A Coruna sit 8th in LaLiga under Antonio Hidalgo, and their most recent result — a 2-1 win over Osasuna — gives them confidence heading into this trip to Barcelona.
 Espanyol's recent record makes for uncomfortable reading. Three defeats in their last five LaLiga matches, including losses to Racing Santander and Atletico Madrid, have left Sarabia with little margin for error as he settles into his new role.
 Deportivo have shown they can grind out results on the road. A draw with Levante and a Copa del Rey win over Auriense earlier in October showed resilience, though they were beaten by Atletico Madrid in between.
 With Espanyol needing points to stabilise their season and Deportivo looking to push further up the table, this fixture has real stakes for both sides.
